evidence_spans.source_text: Fig. 18 tracks two properties of the rollouts each method trains on: rollout length (mean generated tokens per rollout) and self-correction word density.

We measure self-correction with a lexical word density. We count case-insensitive, whole-word occurrences of a fixed set of self-correction words, {wait, but, hmm, actually, hold, however, yet, oh, alternatively, no, ah, oops, well}, in the generated completion (prompt excluded).
Over the last 10 shared steps, OPD’s rollouts are 7–113% longer than Semi-OPD’s in 15 of 16 pairs.
